name: Infection Analyse Results - Part 2
content: We now know for sure that the parasite can be contained by honey, but it looks like honey alone is not enough. The blue plasma we harvested from the blue fish seems to be necessary to make the vaccine effective, as it carries the compound without degrading it. We are currently testing different combinations of honey and the plasma to find the optimal formula for the vaccine. We are hopeful that we will soon have a viable vaccine that can be used to treat infected individuals and prevent the spread of the infection.
